products.name: Green Tea #2
products.description: Longjing is one of the ten "Famous Teas of China". It is made of small tea leaves and buds, thanks to which it is drunk for a long time, and has a bright aroma and rich taste. In the manufacture of thin and flat leaves are obtained.

products.name: Imperial Crimson
products.description: Hand-rolled red tea from the misty Sichuan highlands. Slowly oxidised, it brews a deep crimson cup with a round, honeyed body and no bitterness, even on a long steep.

products.name: Midnight Oolong
products.description: A rock oolong grown between the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains and charcoal-roasted over several nights. Mineral and smoky, it opens up over many short infusions.

products.name: Velvet Jasmine
products.description: Spring green tea layered with fresh jasmine blossoms over seven nights, until the leaves carry the flower's perfume. Silky, floral and calming.

products.name: Golden Peak
products.description: Golden buds picked by hand in Yunnan's ancient tea gardens. A rare red tea with a malty depth, a velvet texture and a long, sweet finish.

products.name: Lunar Silver
products.description: A bright high-grown red tea from Ceylon's Dimbula Valley, picked in the cool season. Crisp and lively, it takes a drop of milk beautifully.

products.name: Alpine Mist
products.description: The first spring picking of a Darjeeling estate, lightly oxidised. Delicate and floral, with the famous muscatel note of the Himalayan foothills.
